_comment: Festival events. Activated automatically when system date falls within window. Dates given as month-day; year-agnostic.

events.description_zh: 新年新气象，种一片喜庆农场
events.description_en: Lunar New Year — plant a festive farm
events._lunar_note: Lunar date is year-dependent. V1 hardcodes for the next 3 years; the code looks up by current date.
_storekeeper_greetings_zh: 新年快乐！今年是 [生肖] 年，种一盆年橘讨吉利吧。
腊月二十三小年到，东方超市的年货货架已经摆好了。
记得吃饺子！游戏里种的韭菜可以包饺子皮的好馅~
春节限定的水仙花已经上架啦，水培装的，10 天就开花。
新年新气象，今年想种点什么新作物试试吗？
_storekeeper_greetings_en: Happy Lunar New Year! Plant a kumquat for good fortune.
The Spring Festival shelves at Eastern Market are stocked. Come visit!
Don't forget the dumplings! Chive from your farm makes great filling.
Limited narcissus flowers are now in shop — bloom in 10 days.
New year, new crops. What will you try this year?
events.real_world_promo_hint_zh: 现实小贴士：东方超市春节期间「八角」全场 7 折，包饺子炖肉都用得上。
events.real_world_promo_hint_en: Real-world tip: Eastern Market has star anise on sale during Spring Festival — perfect for dumplings and braising.

events.description_zh: 清明时节，种艾草做青团
events.description_en: Qingming — plant mugwort for green rice balls
events._note: V1 placeholder — implement later. Mugwort crop and 青团 mini-game in V2.
_storekeeper_greetings_zh: 清明时节雨纷纷，记得给家人打个电话。
想吃青团了，东方超市艾草到货了。
_storekeeper_greetings_en: Qingming is a quiet day to remember family.
Mugwort is in stock at Eastern Market — for making green rice balls.

events.description_zh: 端午包粽子，挂艾草，吃咸鸭蛋
events.description_en: Make zongzi, hang mugwort, eat salted duck eggs
events._note: V2 — add 粽叶, 糯米, 蜜枣 crops + zongzi-wrapping mini-game
_storekeeper_greetings_zh: 端午安康！今年要包甜粽还是咸粽？
_storekeeper_greetings_en: Happy Dragon Boat Festival! Sweet or savory zongzi this year?

events.description_zh: 月圆人圆，种芋头、柚子、桂花
events.description_en: Full moon, family reunion — grow taro, pomelo, osmanthus
_storekeeper_greetings_zh: 中秋节快乐！今晚月亮特别圆。
拼齐芋头 + 柚子 + 桂花，就是一盘中秋的家。
东方超市的月饼已经到货——双黄莲蓉、抹茶豆沙、海盐流心。
「八月桂花遍地开」——你的农场也种一棵吧。
_storekeeper_greetings_en: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Tonight the moon is full.
Taro + pomelo + osmanthus — a plate of home.
Mooncakes are in at Eastern Market — double yolk lotus, matcha red bean, salted caramel.
August osmanthus blossoms — try growing one on your farm.
events.real_world_promo_hint_zh: 现实小贴士：东方超市中秋月饼礼盒系列已上架，预购送桂花茶包。
events.real_world_promo_hint_en: Real-world tip: Eastern Market's mooncake gift boxes are now available — pre-order gets an osmanthus tea pack.

events.description_zh: 敬老节，给爷爷奶奶捎个问候
events.description_en: Honor the elders day — send a hello to grandparents
events._note: V2 — adds chrysanthemum crop, special elder-themed tasks
_storekeeper_greetings_zh: 重阳节，记得给爷爷奶奶外公外婆打个电话。
_storekeeper_greetings_en: Chongyang — call your grandparents today if you can.

events.description_en: Eat dumplings on the longest night
events._note: V2 — add dumpling-folding mini-game, requires chive harvest
_storekeeper_greetings_zh: 冬至到，吃饺子。北方的传统，南方吃汤圆也行。
_storekeeper_greetings_en: Winter solstice — dumpling day in the north, tangyuan in the south. Both delicious.
